components.name: .Pagination/Item
components.description: One pagination cell. Type = Page | Ellipsis; State = Default | Hover | Selected | Disabled (Ellipsis: Default only); Size = S (size/field/1, 36) | M (size/field/2, 44) = 10 variants. Min-width equals height, so 1–3 digit pages stay square or grow.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Paging control. Variant = Numbered (web: summary, pages, page-size button) | Compact (tablet: ‹ 3 / 52 ›) | Load more (mobile: progress + full-width button) × Size = S | M = 6 variants. Pages are exposed .Pagination/Item instances; Previous/Next are Flat icon Buttons; Page size opens a Dropdown menu (24 / 48 / 96). Page size is a nested Select (Filled, S 36 / M 44), exposed.
